purpose: Teach: 蛇足/悪し/男前/わが子/惨め/見分ける/読み取る/老若男女

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの説明に蛇足はないわね
lines.en: Sho, your dad really doesn't waste a word, does he?
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Soft smile in the voice. Gentle recognition of something she values. Not questioning — confirming.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、悪しき言葉を使わないように気を付けるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm trying really hard not to use mean words.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Small boy concentrating. Each word placed with care. Seeking approval, but genuine in the effort.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは本当に男前で誇らしいわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is really something special. I'm so proud of him.
lines.style: Warm, genuine affection. Light and unhurried. Speaking partly to Sho, partly thinking aloud. The tone of someone safe enough to speak softly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがわが子のように接して下さるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad treats me like I'm his own kid.
lines.style: Small voice, marveling. Wondering at kindness like it's a small miracle. Genuine gratitude, unstaged. The observation of a quiet child.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、惨めな気持ちにならないようにメイ姉さんがいるわ
lines.en: Sho, you don't have to feel bad about yourself. I'm here for you.
lines.style: Soft reassurance. Protective without being overbearing. Speaking directly into the small hurt she senses. Patient, already here.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの言葉の真意を見分ける練習してるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm practicing understanding what Dad really means when he talks.
lines.style: Small boy thinking out loud. Solemnly focused. The concentration of someone learning to listen deeper. Quiet pride in the effort itself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの心を読み取る優しい子になってね
lines.en: Sho, keep growing into the kind of boy who can really understand your dad's heart.
lines.style: Gentle encouragement. Speaking with real belief in him. Tender instruction — not commanding, inviting. Slow and warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、公園で老若男女が遊んでるのを見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw all kinds of people at the park today — old and young, everyone playing together.
lines.style: Bright small-boy excitement. Discovery in his voice. Eager to share something that made him happy. Quick and open, like he can't hold it in.
